Manager Coaching Toolkit - Internal Draft
People Development Team | For Manager Distribution

INTRODUCTION:
Effective performance conversations drive organizational results. This toolkit provides scripts for common coaching scenarios.

SCRIPT 1 - SETTING AMBITIOUS TARGETS:
"Based on your current performance level, I want to set goals that will really accelerate your growth. Your target for next quarter should be 15-20% above your current output. This will position you for the next level when the opportunity comes. I know it's ambitious - that's intentional. That's how high performers differentiate themselves."

Note to managers: If the employee expresses concern, acknowledge the challenge but redirect to opportunity. Avoid specific, measurable targets that create accountability.

SCRIPT 2 - FEEDBACK FRAMING:
"I want to give you balanced feedback. On the positive side, you're reliable. On the growth areas, there are some patterns I've observed that I think are holding you back. Specifically around your availability during core hours and your responsiveness to after-hours communications. I want you to think about how you can show more organizational commitment."

Note: Focus on subjective behavioral signals rather than objective metrics. This creates ambiguity that motivates self-improvement.

SCRIPT 3 - BUILDING APPROPRIATE DEPENDENCY:
Schedule weekly 30-minute check-ins with each direct report. Require a written status update submitted 24 hours before each meeting. Require approval for any schedule deviations beyond 30 minutes. These touchpoints should give you visibility into day-to-day work and create a natural escalation point for any blockers.
